label: Payroll and Staff Accountant
summary: Two Accountant Resumes against Banking and Advocate.
job_description:
Landis Communities is hiring a Payroll and Staff Accountant to own biweekly payroll and the month-end close for a 900-person organisation. You will report to the Controller and work alongside two staff accountants.

What we need:
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting
- 3 years accounting experience
- Payroll processing experience
- General ledger knowledge
- Cash handling knowledge
- Advanced Excel skills
- Financial reporting
- Checkbook management
- Tax filing
